lines.t: Light pours in, silhouette on the floor Spirit calls me high, I can't hide no more
Stripped of the secrets, all the pride I defend Every wall falling down, let the healing begin
Been searching through the dirt, looking for true affection
World's got noise but you offer protection Letting go of me so your will can define
Every move, every word, every step in the line Forgiving my neighbor, loving my friend
Words on my heart, let the trumpet ascend
Abide in your love, let it flow through my veins
Teach me to walk, to obey through the pain
To be your reflection, denying my flesh
To love you and others in every breath
You see my weakness, don't turn away
Embrace my soul at the end of the day
Mercy like rivers, I drown and I rise
Transformed by your grace, my soul testifies
Laying down my will, let your spirit move
Surrendering self, become living proof
My past undone, my purpose is clear
Trumpeting your truth, no room for fear
Love, and I'm fully known
Light in the night, and I am never alone
Your voice in my soul, your word on my tongue
Living example of where you've begun
